notes: Requires env_keep+=LD_PRELOAD in sudo -l. The malicious library's _init() runs before the target binary's main(), so it drops a root shell the instant the sudo command loads it.
name: Shared Libraries - LD_PRELOAD via sudo
description: If sudoers has env_keep+=LD_PRELOAD, a command you may run with sudo will load your malicious shared library first - whose _init() spawns a root shell.

steps.label: 3. Run an allowed sudo command with LD_PRELOAD

defense.why_it_works: The LD_PRELOAD environment variable causes the dynamic linker to load a specified shared library before all others. If sudo preserves LD_PRELOAD (env_keep+=LD_PRELOAD in sudoers), running any sudo command loads the attacker's library first. A constructor function (_init) in the malicious library calls setuid(0)/setgid(0) and executes /bin/bash before the real command runs.
defense.prerequisites: sudo privileges for at least one command. sudoers has 'env_keep+=LD_PRELOAD' (misconfiguration). Ability to compile a shared library.
defense.impact: Root shell achieved by prepending a malicious shared library to any sudo command. The _init constructor runs with root privileges before the actual command, dropping a root shell.
defense.detection: sudo command executed with LD_PRELOAD environment variable set. Unusual .so file loaded by sudo process. Auditd: execve with LD_PRELOAD in environment by non-root before sudo. EDR: root shell spawned from sudo with unexpected library.
defense.artifacts: Auditd: sudo execution with LD_PRELOAD in environment | Process log: /bin/bash spawned from sudo with root uid | Malicious .so file in /tmp
defense.prevention: Remove 'env_keep+=LD_PRELOAD' from /etc/sudoers. The default sudoers should NOT preserve LD_PRELOAD (it is stripped by sudo by default). Audit sudoers regularly for env_keep entries. Use 'Defaults env_reset' to clear all environment variables in sudo sessions.
defense.misconfiguration: sudoers file contains 'Defaults env_keep+=LD_PRELOAD', allowing users to preserve this dangerous variable when running sudo commands.
defense.vulnerable_config:
# Vulnerable sudoers
Defaults env_keep+=LD_PRELOAD

# Attack: any sudo command can be abused
sudo LD_PRELOAD=/tmp/root.so /usr/sbin/apache2 restart
defense.secure_config:
# Secure sudoers -- reset environment (default)
Defaults env_reset
# Do NOT add env_keep+=LD_PRELOAD

# Verify no env_keep entries for dangerous vars:
sudo cat /etc/sudoers | grep env_keep
defense.evasion: The _init constructor runs before main() and before any argument processing -- the sudo command appears normal in logs but the library runs first.
